scope: Static source-review entry groups; anchors approximate line ranges at baseline, not proof of call coverage. Main/java paths relative to org/nasedka/app unless flavor/manifest prefix. No production code modified.

groups.role: Lifecycle, render, navigation, incubation reads/writes, settings, dialogs, SAF/restore callbacks
groups.boundary: One render or complete accepted user callback (including DB handles, settings and required scheduling); no lease across dialog lifetime
groups.guard: Screen/form/SAF generation and view epoch; reject stale input, keep unsubmitted data and reopen explicitly

groups.role: Farm render, dialogs, flock/feed/finance/nest/task/egg movements and transfer, reports
groups.boundary: Complete render or form submit including cross-db lookup+mutation; not individual helper
groups.guard: Captured form token validated inside admission; no stale Batch/group/task ID or stale report

groups.role: All SQLiteOpenHelper opens, CRUD, migrations, transactions and cursor lifetime
groups.boundary: Require caller-owned operation context; assert at actual DB access; close helpers/cursors before releasing
groups.guard: Test-only isolated schema construction separately allowed, no runtime bypass or create-on-recovery

groups.role: Snapshot, SAF export/read, legacy recover/switch, staging, restore
groups.boundary: SAF read/validate before exclusive restore; snapshot bytes under lease then SAF output outside; exclusively stage/prepare/restore/recover and close handles
groups.guard: No switchBoth/recover bypass; gate on validated journal state; no automatic mixed pair

groups.role: CSV read and SAF output currently shares DB lifetime
groups.boundary: Materialize immutable CSV bytes under lease; output outside lease
groups.guard: Capture export selection generation at picker launch and compare before read

groups.role: Managed settings and other keys share incuba_settings XML; canonical old/new snapshot
groups.boundary: All app settings access/writes under admitted context; no exposed unguarded editor; critical generation/restore commit checked
groups.guard: New local UUID, absent vs present, no import from backup; preserve unrelated keys; versioned internal codec compatibility

groups.role: Incubation plan, tick, diagnostics, snooze, legacy pending intent cancellation
groups.boundary: Coordinator first, scheduler second; preferably remove static synchronized after coverage verified; nested same owner
groups.guard: Generation-qualified action identity; reschedule after recovery; no advance watermark when rejected

groups.role: Farm tasks, nest checks, deliver/reschedule, notifications, receiver
groups.boundary: Whole receive/deliver/reschedule logical operation; same owner for nesting
groups.guard: Versioned tick, regenerate schedule; reject old tick; no watermark mutation while busy

groups.boundary: Nonblocking try admission, bounded work; allowlist BootReceiver actions
groups.guard: DONE/SNOOZE stale rejected; busy leaves actionable notification and explicit retry; system ticks coalesce and reconstruct on READY

groups.role: Action and content PendingIntent, notification display/cancel, sound preview
groups.boundary: Data-derived notifications within admitted operation; system-only audio diagnostics separate
groups.guard: URI/request identity includes generation, extras alone insufficient; stale content intent safe navigation

groups.role: Background network/update cache and download state in same prefs; callbacks render UI
groups.boundary: Network/download/hash outside coordinator; short guarded prefs read/write and callback re-admission; coalesce disposable cache
groups.guard: Do not retain stale activity or write managed keys; cannot bypass restore through same preferences file

groups.role: Startup recovery, exported launcher/boot receiver, nonexported FileProvider
groups.boundary: Application-scoped STARTING gate before any data access; background recovery; validate merged manifests
groups.guard: No explicit android:process in source manifests, verify all merged variants; fail closed; distinguish fresh install from missing DB after restore

groups.boundary: Only under exclusive restore/recovery ownership; no external calls in partial generation
groups.guard: Resolve legacy first only if no conflicting v2; verify old/new canonical prefs incl generation, check journal absence before READY

limitations: Initial broad automated scan hit tool-call ceiling; targeted source reads covered listed groups and helper scan. Not a full generated bytecode/merged manifest or callback graph proof.
Exact per-call-site mapping and executable coverage gate needed before integration.
No runtime tests of coordinator yet.
